purpose: Teach: 強姦/使徒/於い/草子/罎/謂/廣/來

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のハラスメント、つまり強姦に類する事案には毅然と対処しろ
lines.en: Our company handles any form of sexual harassment or misconduct with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for interpretation. Eyes steady. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の使徒、つまり後継者を社内で育成します
lines.en: Understood. We'll cultivate the next generation of leaders from within our ranks.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight pause after the opening word to acknowledge the directive. Professional but not stiff. Committing to action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外市場に於いてもブランドを守れ
lines.en: Protect our brand reputation in overseas markets as well.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. No question mark in the voice. A clear statement of expectation. Brief. The kind of order that doesn't need elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社史の冊子、つまり社誌草子の保存版を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure we preserve our company history in an archival edition.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Taking mental note. Not rushing—showing he's absorbed the instruction fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品の容器、つまり罎、つまり瓶のデザインを刷新しろ
lines.en: Our company needs a complete redesign of the product packaging.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Tone suggests this is both a priority and non-negotiable. Measured delivery—this is business, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の所謂、つまり謂わゆる不正に毅然と対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond firmly to any employee misconduct without exception.
lines.style: Resolute, matching the gravity. A slight edge of certainty in the delivery. Not defensive—simply stating what will be done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、廣島支店、つまり旧字廣の支店を中心地に置け
lines.en: Our Hiroshima branch will be repositioned as the central hub.
lines.style: Authoritative, matter-of-fact. The weight of strategic decision. No hesitation. Brief and final—this has been decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。來客、つまり来客記録を厳密に管理します
lines.en: Understood. Visitor records will be maintained with strict precision.
lines.style: Crisp closing acknowledgment. Quick, efficient delivery. A slight finality at the end—the meeting's purpose has been covered.
